scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && nuxi dev playgrounds/i18n
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare docs && nuxi prepare playgrounds/i18n && nuxi prepare playgrounds/basic && nuxi prepare playgrounds/standalone && nuxi prepare playgrounds/ui
scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run prepack && changelogen --release && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
